fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology MRVL expands AI infrastructure market through custom silicon business, with 2028 revenue expected to increase more than twofold year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Expanded commercial contracts with Tier 1 hyperscalers secure diverse solution supply opportunities from AI accelerators to storage controllers.
fields.summary_ko.2: Competitive strength is enhanced through strategic partnership with NVIDIA and high-speed connectivity technology combination, though customer concentration risk and margin pressure concerns remain.
